author: Record Staff
title: Altoona tops Hayward in baseball playoff - NewsBreak
text:
By Record Staff ,
17 hours ago The Hayward Hurricanes baseball team finished their season with a 4-10 loss to the Altoona Railroaders in the WIAA regional semifinal playoff Tuesday June 2 at Cinder City Park.
In the first inning, Ryker Chipman walked, stole second and scored on an error to give the Canes a 1-0 lead.
Hayward took a 2-1 lead in the third inning when Chipman reached second base on an error and Trace Marino singled him home.
Altoona scored six runs in the fourth inning on four hits, two walks and a sacrifice fly.
The Canes added a run in the fifth inning on a single by Trace Marino and RBI double by Mac Seiling.
Altoona scored a run in the fifth on two hits and a sacrifice fly, and two runs in the sixth on three hits including a two-run triple.
The Railroaders finished with 10 hits, two errors and six left on base. The Canes had six hits, one error and six runners stranded.
Starting pitcher Mac Seiling took the loss for Hayward, giving up six hits and six runs while walking two and striking out one in 3 1/3 innings. Gavin Luttke earned the win for Altoona.
The Canes finished their season with a 11-13 record. Altoona improved to 14-12 on the season and advanced to face Somerset for the regional championship.
